narrative: Teams can now declare Copier modules in their repo overlay config and apply them directly to repositories via Git Trees API — no pull request, no manual file copying. The python_service and terraform_module templates render offline, land atomically on the default branch, and record their applied state in per-module answers files. Policy enforcement gates which modules each team may request. The rulesets 403 split, recording transport, and updated plan output complete the foundation for I5's three-way reconcile.
